desktopApi.doc: #5: a 'complete' update answers with that reply's lifetime, decided by the host (shared/behaviors/reply-linger/).

desktopApi.name: userGaze
desktopApi.doc: I-081: where pose sensing says the user is, for her gaze (companion window only; null otherwise or while sensing gives nothing). Memory only.

desktopApi.name: voiceCallFiller
desktopApi.doc: I-091 step 2: her pick of a short sound for this pause (null: none this time), and the clips of her current voice.

desktopApi.name: voiceCallTurn
desktopApi.doc:
I-099/I-100: in a call, the call's own window asks the local Smart Turn model whether the user's current turn sounds finished
(the last 8 s of it, 16 kHz float samples). Back: the probability that it is complete, or null (go by silence). Nothing is kept.

desktopApi.name: voiceCallVad
desktopApi.doc:
I-099: in a call, the call's own window asks the local Silero VAD about one microphone chunk (16 kHz float samples,
`reset`: a new call's stream). Back: one speech probability per 32 ms window, or null (go by loudness). Nothing is kept.

desktopApi.name: voiceKeep
desktopApi.doc: Dev-only 保存她念出来的声音 (controls only; the host answers { available: false } on a stable or packaged build, and null where it is not registered).

members.name: agent
members.type: { workingDirectory: string; model: string; writable: boolean; }

members.name: crisisRegion
members.doc:
I-117 「所在地区（求助信息用）」: which region's help line the safety card shows first. 'auto' (and absent in older files): guessed
from the system time zone (shared/safety/crisis-lines.ts guessCrisisRegion).

members.name: experienceJournal
members.doc:
体验记录 (E2, "保留体验记录（只存本机）"): default off; host-owned intent (setExperienceJournal), never a stale form field.
On: `<profile>/journal/<local date>.jsonl` (electron/memory/journal/writer.ts).

members.name: innerLoop
members.doc: Inner loop (L1): she decides by herself at mood opportunities. Default on; host-owned intent (setInnerLoop).

members.name: motionLayers
members.type: { gesture: AssetRef | null; expression: AssetRef | null; } | undefined

members.name: pet
members.type: { visible: boolean; alwaysOnTop: boolean; clickThrough: boolean; followMouse: boolean; fps: number; breath: number; scale?: number | undefined; size?: { width: number; height: number; } | undefined; }

members.name: proactiveTalk
members.doc:
她主动找你说话: 'less' | 'normal' (default, = today) | 'more'. Scales how often her own moments come
(shared/behaviors/inner-rhythm/); the card's speech caps are not touched. Absent in older files: 'normal'.

members.name: selfLook
members.doc:
I-085 她自己看一眼: with 「发图片」 on, she may take a look at the user herself when her mood makes
her want to (electron/initiative/self-look/): one haiku call each, at most 4 an hour. Default on; it never turns a sense on. Absent: on.

members.name: version
members.doc: 2 since R29f (the default render rate moved to 60 fps; a version-1 file on the old default 30 moves once).

members.name: voice
members.type: { enabled: boolean; voiceURI: string; rate: number; volume: number; moodInfluence?: number | undefined; firstChunk?: "sentence" | "comma" | undefined; pauseTalk?: boolean | undefined; }
members.doc:
`moodInfluence`: 0–100 % (default 50) of the reply mood's small rate/pitch nudge on the system voice (R02).
`firstChunk` (I-029): where a streaming Claude reply's first read-aloud piece ends: 'sentence' (default, the first whole
sentence) or 'comma' (may end at a comma inside the first sentence; shared/voice/first-speech-chunk.ts). Both voices.
`pauseTalk` (F7 停停说说, default off = absent): haiku decides, from her mood and character, where her bubbles after the first
pause and whether she stops to wait for the user (shared/behaviors/pause-talk/); the first sentence never waits.

members.name: motionLayers
members.type: { gesture: string | null; expression: string | null; } | undefined

members.name: shareTicket
members.doc:
Set by the host on a frame it took from sharing for a message (electron/senses/look-attachments.ts); the window sends it back
unchanged. The host only trusts tickets it handed out itself. A snapshot the user attached by hand has none.

AudioReadingRefusal.doc:
Why 「和她一起听」 hears only the rhythm (I-016, Codex T-207): the local recognizer's reasons, or 'not-local' — 识别方式 is the
compatible address, and played sound is transcribed only on this computer (the approved plan: "声音只在本机，转写只在本机").

CameraRefusal.doc:
Why 「姿势识别」 stayed off (electron/senses/media-runtime.ts): the local pose component is missing (the control window asks),
it is still downloading or installing, or local sensing could not be set up at all. None of them turns 「发图片」 on
instead: that is the user's own separate switch (I-036).

members.name: line
members.doc:
2026-11-23: the host's number of a line from her full-screen box (electron/unbound/say-ack.ts). The host sends it on only while the
line is still open: one the box already gave up on is refused, so a line goes out at most once and never after "没发出去".

members.name: pauseCut
members.doc:
F7 停停说说 (switch on only): the user spoke while her previous reply (`id`) had shown only `shown` characters in its bubbles.
A number, never text: the host takes the rest from its own copy of that reply.

members.name: sentAt
members.doc: Renderer wall-clock send time (Date.now()), used only for developer-mode latency timing.

members.name: waits
members.doc: 2026-11-22: where the window spent the time between sentAt and this request (ms each; timing only, shared/brain/send-drop/drop.ts).

members.name: readoutControl
members.doc: Host-classified local control turn. It must preserve unrelated playback.

members.name: speaker
members.doc: I-209 step 4: the name of the one answering when she is someone else on the full-screen stage (not the desktop companion).

members.name: speakerId
members.doc: I-209 stage voice: her card id with `speaker`: the window reads this reply in her own voice.

members.name: contextLost
members.doc: null when no WebGL canvas exists.

members.name: frameAdvanced
members.doc: An animation frame actually ran shortly after the probe started.

PetPresentationSample.doc: Companion renderer's own drawing state, reported for developer diagnostics only.

PetReplyPieces.doc: End offsets into the reply text (last = text.length). 'paragraphs' keeps one bubble; 'bubbles' gives each piece its own.

members.name: interactionOpacity
members.doc: Visual interaction fade only; never renews or pauses the reply lifetime.

members.name: pieces
members.doc: Ordinary chat only, sent with `text`: display-only layout of that exact text (R27).

members.name: segmented
members.doc: Ordinary completed reply only; proactive and ambient presentation keep their original mode.

members.name: t
members.doc: Milliseconds since the host process started.

PetWindowDiagnosticEntry.doc: Bounded developer log of companion window facts; never contains settings, paths or chat.

members.name: baseUrl
members.doc: Unused by Claude Code; kept only because it is part of the stored chat-memory scope.

members.name: model
members.doc: Claude Code model alias or id; empty follows Claude Code's own default.

ProviderKind.doc:
Claude-only edition. Settings saved with the retired
"openai" / "ollama" kinds, or the Codex edition's "codex", load as "claude"
(electron/settings/validation.ts validateProvider); their old encrypted key is never decrypted.

RuntimePatch.doc:
`cameraImages` / `cameraLocal`: the two camera switches (I-036). `cameraSharing: false` turns both off; `cameraSharing: true`
alone is the old single switch and means 「姿势识别」 (what the camera meant before I-036).

members.name: cameraHeld
members.doc: 「发图片」 is on but the user said not to look (electron/senses/look-turns.ts): no frame is taken until the user asks her to look.

members.name: cameraImages
members.doc:
Camera switch 「发图片」 on (I-036): the owner window keeps a small frame ready and each message the
user sends carries it (a clear one when the user asks her to look); no component download.

members.name: cameraLocal
members.doc:
Camera switch 「姿势识别」 on (I-001 local pose sensing): frames stay in the hidden sensor window and the local inference
process. I-036: one of the two independent switches under 「摄像头共享」; `cameraSharing` is true while
either is on.

members.name: cameraRefused
members.doc: Only in the reply to the window that asked to turn the camera on and was refused (never in the broadcast state).

members.name: voiceRefused
members.doc: Only in the reply to the window that asked to turn voice input on and was refused (never in the broadcast state).

members.name: outage
members.doc: On a chat `error` that is Claude being unavailable (shared/brain/chat-availability.ts): what she says instead of a technical error.

members.name: speechBeats
members.doc: On a chat `beats` event only.

members.name: type
members.doc: 'beats' (边说边演, docs/claude/2026-11-20-speech-beats-2-4.md): her beats for this reply, in `speechBeats`; `text` is empty.

members.name: engine
minimized
members.doc: I-171: the window is only minimized (a step away: the reply, the bubble and the warm process are kept), not hidden; absent means false.

members.name: petVisible
members.doc: Host-owned requested companion visibility, independent of this window's role.

members.name: visible
members.doc: Actual visibility of this sender's native window, including minimization.

WindowVisibilityState.doc: A window's native visibility as the host reports it (moved here from shared/contracts.ts, which re-exports it; wiring rewrite step 2).
